##### Project general facts

The Riff by Arada is a collection of six mid-rise residential buildings within East Village, a creative neighbourhood at the heart of the community that also includes the Link and Solo projects. Clean exterior design is enlivened by bold vertical lines on the facades, while each building rises above two basement parking levels and a spacious ground floor to six residential floors. The collection offers stylish studios and one-bedroom apartments designed for students, young couples, creatives and professionals.

The neighbourhood celebrates art and community, with murals, street art, sculptures and galleries showcasing local and international artists. Residents enjoy a swimming pool with a pool deck, a fully equipped gym, sports courts, an outdoor children's play area and a splash zone, while outdoor trails, landscaped parks, picnic areas and outdoor dining create welcoming places to meet neighbours. A co-working lounge, a laundry and shops and cafes on the ground floor add everyday convenience.

Residences feature open-plan layouts, premium finishes and well-equipped kitchens, designed as practical, light-filled homes for a young and active generation. Efficient floor plans make the most of every square foot, while balconies and large windows bring in natural light and views of the green walkways around the buildings. Homes are delivered semi-furnished, with fitted kitchens and appliances, leaving furniture to the owner's own taste and making each apartment easy to personalise.

##### Location description and benefits

Aljada is a large master-planned community in Sharjah that brings together homes, offices, schools, hotels, retail and leisure within one integrated urban setting. Its heart is Madar, a family entertainment destination designed by Zaha Hadid Architects, while SABIS International School, the Il Teatro cultural district, the Arada central business district and Aljada Business Park sit within walking distance of the buildings.

Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road and University City Road connect residents with every part of Sharjah and Dubai. University City is a short drive away, City Centre Al Zahia and Sharjah International Airport are close by, and Dubai International Airport and Downtown Dubai are within comfortable driving distance, making the location practical for students, commuters and frequent travellers.

Aljada is a freehold community open to international buyers and one of the largest mixed-use destinations in Sharjah. Compact studios and one-bedroom homes close to universities and business districts attract students and young professionals, supporting steady rental demand. Accessible entry prices compared with Dubai, integrated amenities and strong road links underpin attractive rental yields and long-term value for owners and investors.
